title: Budget-clock migration B2: engram_host_adapter.rs middle region (about lines 9100-12100)
outcome: An audited migration, through the state-owned clock boundary from slice 1, of the fixtures in src/tests/engram_host_adapter.rs at about lines 9100-12100. Navigation counts at 593c783: 27 enable_test_project_engram calls and the direct deadline_ms site :10337. The batch lists each converted test's deadline, elapsed and wait sources and its assertions, adds focused boundary controls, and keeps the negative scheduling and timeout assertions. It inventories the transitive test callers of every changed shared fixture, including indirect clock selection and existing time hooks. A full run validates the batch; it does not classify it. No blanket Real declarations and no production change. The decomposition is note 7c38dafc37c5410391ab42881615461a on the parent, with f842da36050949b3ba884f5884c64766. Criteria are to be agreed before this batch starts.
acceptance: Every test in the B2 region of src/tests/engram_host_adapter.rs is classified as reaching an Engram budget or not. Region: from enum EngramTerminationCase (:9261 at d6b9442) and assert_terminal_case_checkpoints_once (:9269) through runtime_terminal_callbacks_abandon_blocked_engram_begin_before_queue_drain (:12469); it ends before RestartEngramControlTransport (:12479), whose boot-recovery transports serve B3. A test that reaches a budget chooses its clock through the slice-1 boundary before Engram is enabled and before any target or worker snapshot: either the shared scripted clock, or a declared Real with its reason in a comment. A test that calls enable_test_project_engram or real_fixture_engram_settings, or sets deadline_ms, but reaches no budget ends with assert_engram_budget_clock_unread. Floor: the region holds at least the 29 tests, the 27 enable_test_project_engram calls, the 4 real_fixture_engram_settings calls, and the direct deadline_ms sites :10441 and :10647 at d6b9442; the inventory note maps each to its position at the batch's base.

A note lists, for each converted test, its deadline, elapsed and wait sources and its assertions. A note inventories the transitive test callers of every shared fixture the batch changes, including indirect clock selection and existing time hooks.

Every converted expiry test does one of two things. Either it advances the same scripted clock across the causal boundary, with an unadvanced positive control asserted in that test, or it declares Real. The separate negative scheduling and timeout assertions are kept, and no expectation is weakened.

No blanket Real declarations and no production change. enable_test_project_engram, real_fixture_engram_settings and every other fixture used outside the region stay unchanged. Edits stay within the B2 region and the helpers it owns (assert_terminal_case_checkpoints_once, assert_terminal_callback_abandons_blocked_begin and their enums). It changes one of them only if criterion 2's transitive-caller inventory shows no caller outside the B2 region, or lists and converts each such caller within this batch.
The full five-stage gate passes on the exact reviewed tree; its run directory and fingerprint are cited in a note.
